protocol.rationale_frozen_before_training: Temperature and axis-ratio validation MAEs are slightly worse than prior-median diagnostics. A Gaussian in scaled-logit prior coordinates cannot exactly represent the uniform prior when data are uninformative; Gaussian probit(prior-unit) coordinates can. One otherwise identical fit isolates this prior-family representation choice. It cannot restore PCA information, remove nonlinear multimodality or prove data sufficiency.
protocol.change: Only the fixed supervised target transform and inverse: use ndtri(prior-unit) / ndtr. Same 3906 measured inputs, train-only normalization/PCA32, 32-unit tanh network and full covariance Gaussian output.
protocol.stopping_and_selection: One fit only, best validation NLL with unchanged patience/min_delta. Within a fixed coordinate transform the label Jacobian is constant across epochs. Compare original/probe density scores only in common prior-unit u coordinates including exact Jacobians.
comparison_metrics: All four original-unit MAE/RMSE against frozen model and prior medians
Paired source-resampling intervals for MAE differences
Joint and marginal prior-unit density NLL relative to exact uniform prior
Central 50/80/95% marginal coverage and widths with 67-source sample-size caveat
protocol.decision: Report all outcomes, including degradation. No automatic model replacement, no retries for score improvement and no second hyperparameter/architecture probe. A better validation score is development evidence only; independent final evaluation would need a separately approved protected set.
protocol.data: 794 train /397 sources; 134 validation /67 sources. Existing test/challenge labels and test scoring forbidden. Simulator/datasets/run_03/followup_01 remain unchanged.
